title_en: Xi'an Municipal People's Procuratorate v. Pei Guoliang — dispute over infringement of trade secrets
ruling_gist_en: 1. According to Article 86(5) of the Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues concerning the Implementation of the Criminal Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China, where an actor steals another person's technical secrets for use by the company in which he works, thereby causing particularly serious consequences to the owner of the technical secrets, when pursuing the criminal liability of the actor for the crime of infringing trade secrets, the company in which the actor works may, upon the request of the plaintiff in the ancillary civil action, be listed as a defendant in the ancillary civil action and be jointly held liable for civil damages for the infringement.
